settings.ceCategoriesFromFoldersHelp: Writes categories.yml with one category per folder, shown in the item browser (/ce). Subfolders become subcategories.

share.title: Share project
share.nameHelp: The others see it when you change something.

stopConfirm.title: Stop sharing?
stopConfirm.message:
Your changes will no longer be copied to the shared folder, and the others’ changes will no longer reach you.
Your copy of the project and the folder are kept.

share.stopped: The project is no longer shared.
share.desktopOnly: Sharing only works in the Windows app (ResourcepackBuilder.exe), because it needs access to a folder on your PC. In the browser version you can pass the project on via “Save project file”.
share.sharedHint: Everyone who has opened this folder in ResourcepackBuilder sees your changes after a few seconds – and you see theirs. If two people change the same item at the same time, the last saved change wins. “Undo” only affects your own changes.
share.intro: Share the project through a folder you all use. Changes then reach everyone automatically – in both directions.
share.step1: In OneDrive, Google Drive or Dropbox, create a folder and share it with your friends.
share.step2: Click Choose folder and share below and pick that folder. ResourcepackBuilder puts the project into it.
share.step3: Your friends open the folder in ResourcepackBuilder via Open shared project.

pasteConfig.title: Paste properties
pasteConfig.pasted: Pasted the properties of “{name}” into {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
pasteConfig.apply: Paste into {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
pasteConfig.emptyReplace: Empty in the source – removes this category’s values from the target.
pasteConfig.replaceHelp: The target items get exactly the source’s values in the chosen categories.
pasteConfig.mergeHelp: Only add and overwrite – values that only the target has are kept.
pasteConfig.neverCopied: Never copied: display name, item ID, model and variants, folder and custom_model_data. Custom blocks get a free variation if needed.
